name: Parrot SEO
author: zoniclab

sections.description:
Parrot SEO is a comprehensive SEO plugin designed to help you optimize your WordPress website for search engines. With its modern interface, real-time analysis, and deep integration with both Gutenberg and Elementor, Parrot SEO makes SEO accessible for everyone.

Key Features

SEO Analysis
* Real-time content analysis with actionable recommendations
* Focus keyword optimization
* SEO score and readability score for every post
* Word count, keyword density, and heading structure analysis
* Internal and external link checking

Meta Tags
* Customizable SEO titles and meta descriptions
* Template variables for dynamic content
* Google search preview
* Robots meta tag control (index/noindex, follow/nofollow)
* Canonical URL support

Social Media
* Open Graph tags for Facebook
* Twitter Cards support
* Custom social images
* Social profile integration

Schema Markup
* JSON-LD structured data
* Automatic Article, Organization, and Breadcrumb schema
* Support for multiple schema types: FAQ, HowTo, Recipe, Event, Product, LocalBusiness
* Per-post schema type selection

XML Sitemap
* Automatic sitemap generation
* Customizable content inclusion
* Image sitemap support
* Beautiful sitemap stylesheet
* Automatic search engine ping on publish

Gutenberg Integration
* Dedicated SEO sidebar panel
* Real-time preview
* Character counters
* All SEO settings accessible from the block editor

Elementor Integration
* SEO settings in Elementor page settings
* Breadcrumbs widget
* Table of Contents widget
* Full compatibility with Elementor Pro

Advanced Features
* Bulk analysis and optimization
* Import/Export settings
* Clean head section (remove unnecessary tags)
* Attachment page redirects
* Author/Date archive controls

Why Choose Parrot SEO?

  1. Modern UI – Clean, intuitive interface that’s easy to use
  2. Performance – Lightweight and optimized for speed
  3. Compatibility – Works seamlessly with Gutenberg and Elementor
  4. Comprehensive – All the SEO features you need in one plugin
  5. Developer Friendly – Extensive hooks and filters for customization

External services

This plugin may contact the following third-party services. Use of these services is optional in practice (e.g. the sitemap remains valid and usable without the ping), but enables better discovery of your content.

Google – Sitemap Ping

  • What it is and what it is used for: When the XML sitemap is updated (for example after you publish a post or page), the plugin can notify Google by calling Google’s “Ping” endpoint. This helps Google discover your sitemap URL so it can crawl and index your site.
  • What data is sent and when: Your site’s sitemap URL (e.g. https://yoursite.com/sitemap.xml) is sent to Google as a query parameter when the ping runs. The ping runs automatically when a post or page is published; it is rate-limited to at most once per hour. The request is non-blocking (fire-and-forget) and no cookies or personal data are sent.
  • Service provider: Google LLC.
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the parrot-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Parrot SEO > General to configure your settings
  4. Start optimizing your content!
sections.faq:
Does Parrot SEO work with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes! Parrot SEO has full integration with the WordPress block editor. You’ll find a dedicated SEO sidebar panel where you can manage all SEO settings without leaving the editor.

Is Parrot SEO compatible with Elementor?

Absolutely! Parrot SEO integrates seamlessly with Elementor. SEO settings are available in Elementor’s page settings panel, and we provide custom widgets like Breadcrumbs and Table of Contents.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. Parrot SEO is designed with performance in mind. All analysis happens in the admin area, and the frontend output is minimal and optimized.

Can I use Parrot SEO with other SEO plugins?

We recommend using only one SEO plugin at a time to avoid conflicts. If you’re migrating from another SEO plugin, you can import your settings.

How do I submit my sitemap to Google?

Your sitemap is automatically available at yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml. You can submit this URL to Google Search Console. Parrot SEO also automatically pings search engines when you publish new content.
